# 🏆 Humaira Enterprises | Sales Representative Performance Analytics

An interactive **sales performance dashboard** designed to evaluate individual sales representatives across **profit, sales, and units sold**, helping identify performance patterns, benchmark representatives, and support data-driven sales management.

## 📸 Dashboard Preview

![Sales Representative Performance Dashboard](YOUR-IMAGE-PATH)

## 🎯 Performance Analysis

* 💰 **Profit Performance** — Compared total profit generated by each representative.
* 💵 **Sales Performance** — Analyzed sales contribution across the sales team.
* 📦 **Units Sold** — Evaluated sales volume and representative productivity.
* 🏆 **Performance Benchmarking** — Compared representatives across multiple KPIs.
* 📊 **Top & Lower Performers** — Identified performance gaps and standout contributors.
* 📈 **Target & Performance Tracking** — Designed insights to support ongoing performance reviews.

## 💡 Key Insights

* 🥇 **Chin** generated the highest profit at **₹5,31,402**.
* 💵 Chin also recorded the highest sales at **₹14,09,541**.
* 📦 Chin led in units sold with **277 units**.
* ⭐ **Chin and Jeri** consistently appeared among the strongest performers across profit and sales.
* 📉 **Rhonda** recorded the lowest figures across the key performance metrics analyzed.

## 🧠 Sales Performance Framework

**Representative Data → KPI Analysis → Performance Benchmarking → Gap Identification → Business Recommendations**

The dashboard transforms representative-level sales data into a **management-focused performance view**, making it easier to recognize strong performance, identify improvement areas, and support structured one-on-one reviews.

## 📌 Business Recommendations

* 🔄 Study successful selling approaches used by high-performing representatives.
* 🎯 Provide targeted coaching and mentoring where performance gaps are identified.
* 📈 Use historical performance to establish realistic individual targets.
* 🏅 Consider performance-based recognition and incentive programs.
* 🔁 Review the dashboard regularly to monitor progress over time.
